assessment.supported: Hansoh's 4 June 2026 announcement says China's NMPA accepted an NDA for once-weekly injectable olatorepatide for chronic weight management after the cited Chinese Phase III study.
assessment.unchangedLiveBoundary: Application acceptance is not marketing approval. The announcement does not establish UK authorisation, NICE or NHS access, actual UK supply, individual suitability, comparative benefit or an approved dosing recommendation.
assessment.assetIdentity: This injectable HS-20094 programme is distinct from Hansoh and Merck's oral GLP-1 asset. Regeneron holds rights outside Chinese mainland, Hong Kong and Macau under the cited territorial agreement.
